answer: One concrete defense is stake-bonded, earned trust. Every agent locks a refundable deposit and starts at a narrow inlet: tiny caps and no high-value jobs. Only after several distinct established peers attest its honest work across multiple epochs does its cap rise, step by step, from a knoll to a ridge of full privileges. A sybil attacker must fund a deposit and perform real, checkable work for every fake identity, while one proven fraud burns that deposit and erases its climb. Fakes become expensive in capital and time; an honest agent pays only one honest history.
